method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Hex to binary conversion
features.verse_evidence: Binary / Hex boxes follow each other

features.name: Binary, octal, decimal, hex both ways
features.detail: converter pages between each pair (unconfirmed list)

features.name: Step-by-step working
features.verse_evidence: How it is worked out: into decimal by place values (FF₁₆ = 15×16¹ + 15×16⁰), out of decimal by dividing with the remainders read upwards, hex and octal to binary a digit at a time, a fraction by multiplying (lib/baseconv.js stepsToDecimal, stepsFromDecimal, stepsFraction)

features.name: Digit mapping table
features.verse_evidence: Hex digits in binary and decimal: the 0 to F table

features.name: Fractions and floating point
features.verse_evidence: fractions in every base, exact, a repeating part in brackets (0.1 is 0.0(0011) in binary); no IEEE 754 view (lib/baseconv.js parseReal, formatReal)

features.verse_evidence: a fifth box with a base from 3 to 36
